description: Follow open research on OSF, the Center for Open Science's platform. Search public projects and read their files, wikis and contributors, list preprints on PsyArXiv, SocArXiv and OSF's other preprint servers, look up registrations, researchers and institutions, get citations in any style, and start a workflow when a new preprint is published. No account or API key required.

osf_new_preprint_trigger.description: Runs when a preprint is published on an OSF preprint server, such as PsyArXiv or SocArXiv. Optionally only on one server, in one subject, or for new versions too.

output.author_count: How many authors it has in all.
output.authors: The authors in byline order. Lists carry the first 10; 'Get preprint' carries them all.
output.date_modified: When it was last changed, in UTC (ISO 8601).
output.date_published: When this version went public, in UTC (ISO 8601).
output.date_submitted: When the authors started submitting this version, in UTC (ISO 8601).
output.date_withdrawn: When it was withdrawn, in UTC.
output.guid: The preprint's OSF id, the same for every version, e.g. '5trew'.
output.has_conflict_of_interest: Whether the authors declared a conflict of interest.
output.has_data_links: Whether the authors link their data: 'available', 'no' or 'not_applicable'.
output.has_prereg_links: Whether the study was preregistered and linked: 'available', 'no' or 'not_applicable'.
output.id: This version's OSF id, e.g. '5trew_v4' for version 4. Pass it to 'Get preprint' or 'Get citation'.
output.is_latest_version: Whether this is the preprint's latest version.
output.is_withdrawn: Whether the preprint has been withdrawn.
output.license: The licence the authors chose, e.g. 'CC-By Attribution 4.0 International'.
output.pdf_url: A link that downloads the preprint's main file (its PDF).
output.preprint_doi_url: The preprint's DOI as a link.
output.project_id: The OSF id of the project holding its supplemental materials, if any.
output.published_doi: The DOI of the journal article it became, when the authors added one.
output.published_doi_url: The journal article's DOI as a link.
output.review_state: Where it stands with the server's moderators: 'accepted', 'pending', 'rejected', 'withdrawn' or 'initial'.
output.server: The preprint server's OSF id, e.g. 'psyarxiv' for PsyArXiv.
output.subjects: The subjects it is filed under, the most specific of each.
output.title: The preprint's title.
output.version: The version number: 1 for the first, 2 for a revision.

parameters.description: Only preprints on this server, such as PsyArXiv. Leave blank for every server OSF hosts.
parameters.name: server

parameters.description: Only preprints filed under this subject (or one inside it). Pick a preprint server first: each has its own subjects. Leave blank for every subject.
parameters.name: subject

parameters.description: Run for new preprints only (new, the default), or for new versions of earlier preprints too (all).
parameters.name: versions
